- Confirm retention / audit log commitments for the sandbox instance.
- Request a timeline for template-level redlines so procurement can plan internal approvals.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Subject: Re: Renewal + supplemental scope draft for review — initial legal redlines

Sarah / Jordan,

I reviewed Helio_Amendment_v1_draft and prepared inline/track-changes comments. Key issues from Redwood legal:

1) Term language: we cannot accept an evergreen extension without a clear termination for convenience with 90 days' notice after the second year. Proposed fix: retain the 24-month term but add a termination-for-convenience clause effective after Month 24 with 90 days' notice.

2) Capacity uplift definition: "25% capacity uplift" needs an explicit metric (concurrent tokens/hour or reserved GPU hours). We've proposed adding Exhibit A (capacity schedule) with a measurable baseline and uplift percentages.

3) Sandbox data safety: if the sandbox will contain customer data, we need to limit retention to 30 days and confirm encryption-at-rest + KMS keys; otherwise mark sandbox as TEST DATA ONLY and add explicit prohibition on production PHI/PII.

I've attached Helio_Amendment_v3_redlines.docx with comments. Please review and let us know which items are negotiable.

Also copying Marissa from Solutions so we can align on technical feasibility for the sandbox request.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Helio_Amendment_v3_redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@heliohealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:20:51 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal + supplemental scope draft for review — Helio feedback

Laura, Jordan — thanks for the quick review. Attached is our counterproposal (Helio_Proposed_TermLanguage_v2.docx). On your three points:

- Term: Helio leadership is firm on a 24-month firm term with no early termination except for breach. We can consider a mutual early termination only with 120 days' notice and a pro-rated refund for unused prepaid capacity.
- Capacity metric: happy to accept specifying uplift as a percentage of baseline reserved GPU hours. We'll populate Exhibit A with our baseline numbers for Year 2 by EOD tomorrow.
- Sandbox: the sandbox will contain redacted production data for realistic testing (we'll provide a redaction checklist). Helio requests 90-day retention for integration purposes.

We'd like to set a short call: Wed Jul 18, 10:00 AM PT for a legal-to-legal discussion if that works.

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Senior Procurement Manager, HelioHealth
